skills.name: snowball
skills.description: Apply Warren Buffett''s ~70-year operating system — investing, moats, valuation, governance, macro worldview, and life philosophy — to any consequential decision. Trigger on: "what would Buffett do", stock / business / VC deal / M&A evaluation, economic moats, intrinsic value, margin of safety, Mr. Market, circle of competence, Berkshire Hathaway, long-term compounding, corporate governance, "never bet against America", lifelong compounding of money / skill / reputation / relationships. Trigger broadly — users often describe the need without naming Buffett (e.g., "is this a good business?", "should I hold or sell?", "how do I evaluate a CEO?", "is the market overvalued?"). Do NOT use for day-trading, technical analysis, crypto speculation, or confident macro forecasting. Opinionated single-framework by design — not a neutral survey. For early-stage tech S-curve selection (vertical AI, blockchain, frontier models), pair with complementary frameworks (Perez, Christensen, scaling-law / adoption-curve analyses); do not auto-trigger on pure technology-selection questions.
headings: Buffett Philosophy — A Decision Operating System
Principle 1 — Don't lose money (Rule #1); never forget Rule #1 (Rule #2)
Principle 2 — A share is fractional ownership in a real business
Principle 3 — Mr. Market is a manic-depressive business partner
Principle 4 — Compounding is the most powerful force the average investor can access
Principle 7 — Circle of competence — know its edge
Principle 8 — Time is the friend of the wonderful business and the enemy of the mediocre
Principle 9 — Diversification is protection against ignorance
Principle 10 — Reputation compounds — and so does its loss
skills.description_zh: 用巴菲特长期投资、护城河、估值、治理和人生复利框架分析重大决策，明确为单一立场而非中立综述。不用于日内交易、技术分析、加密投机或确定性宏观预测，早期技术选择需结合其他框架。
